lore: What the tide journal replays settles on the shoals in sorted sandbars. Fresh writes pile up in the shallows; every so often the sorter rakes the bars together into deeper, longer ones. Rake too little and every lookup wades through a dozen bars; rake every time the tide brings sand and the rake wears out before the season ends.

lines.start: Sand's coming in from the journal. Keep the bars few and the rake sharp.
lines.flush: Shallows full. New bar laid down.
lines.compact: Raking the bars together. Longer, deeper, fewer.
lines.win: Season's done. Lookups are quick and the rake still has teeth.
lines.fail_io: The rake's worn through. We merged the same sand too many times.
lines.fail_reads: Too many bars. Every lookup wades the whole shoal.
